hooks.command: bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/probe_hook.sh" SessionStart </dev/null; f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/handoff_current.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo '## Auto-loaded handoff from previous session'; echo; cat "$f"; fi
tee_payload="$(cat || true)"; printf '%s' "$tee_payload" | bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/probe_hook.sh" SessionEnd; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/write_handoff.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

tee_payload="$(cat || true)"; printf '%s' "$tee_payload" | bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/probe_hook.sh" Stop; printf '%s' "$tee_payload" | bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/handoff_turn_append.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
